title: picardDirectImageUnitMorphism
statement: For arbitrary f:X \to S, an O_X-module L, k:W \to S, t:T \to W, and a derived test morphism \xi [def-sc-picard-derived-model-sections], construct a module morphism O_{X_T} \to L_T [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Form the canonical degree-zero morphism m from O_T to p_{T*}L_T exactly as in [def-sc-picard-direct-image-section-map], and define n as the inverse of pullbackObjUnitToUnit followed by the ordinary adjoint transpose of m. This is explicit data, with no witness choice.

def picardDirectImageUnitMorphism {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (L : X.Modules) (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S)
    {T : Scheme.{v}} (t : T ⟶ W)
    (ξ : picardDerivedModelSections
      ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f k)).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
            ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj L))) t) :
    SheafOfModules.unit (moduleRings (pullback f (t ≫ k)).toRingedSpace) ⟶
      (Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (t ≫ k))).obj L
